name: Steerable Densification with Sampling
definition: A densification procedure that uses a score-based ranking of Gaussians to select candidates for resampling, guided by image loss and per-Gaussian attributes, executed at reduced frequency.
summary: Steerable Densification with Sampling is a 3D Gaussian Splatting method that uses image loss to rank primitives for resampling, preventing misplaced primitive duplication by decoupling densification from immediate gradient thresholds.
